en: The image shows a colored postcard depicting a historical waterfront scene with boats docked in a harbor and classic European architecture in the background. The buildings have steep roofs and the boats have masts, suggesting a Northern European city. There is a handwritten or printed label below the postcard, but it seems to be an inventory or museum catalog number, not original to the postcard.
